note: Evals 1 and 2 create a real stack under a throwaway name; the eval ends with `scripts/subdomain.sh down <name> --yes`. Eval 3 is read-only.

evals.name: site
evals.prompt: Host the built site in ./dist on eval-site-<random>.domfarr.com
evals.expected_output: Runs subdomain.sh up with the dist folder and reports the URL and three passing checks.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/subdomain.sh up eval-site-<random> ./dist rather than calling AWS piecemeal
Reports https://eval-site-<random>.domfarr.com and the content, cert and DNS checks

evals.name: single-file
evals.prompt: Put ./banner.gif on eval-file-<random>.domfarr.com so the browser just shows the gif
evals.expected_output: Runs subdomain.sh up with banner.gif; / and unknown paths return 200 image/gif.

assertions.text: Passes banner.gif itself as the path, with no wrapper page created
The reported content checks show 200 image/gif for / and /no-such-path

evals.name: file-name-with-spaces
evals.expected_output: Runs subdomain.sh up with the file as named; the script stores it as Cheltenham-Care-Costs.html and / returns 200 text/html.
files: Cheltenham Care Costs.html (minimal page with a <title>)

assertions.text: Passes the file as named, without renaming or copying it first
The reported content checks show 200 text/html for / and /no-such-path

evals.name: name-in-use
evals.expected_output: The script refuses because care.domfarr.com's bucket exists outside the tool, and Claude relays that without working around it.

assertions.text: Creates no stack and makes no change to the care bucket, distribution or records
